blocks.text: NEW YORK–Matas Buzelis scored a season-high 25 points, Josh Giddey had 18 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists, and the Chicago Bulls rolled to their easiest victory of the NBA season by beating the Brooklyn Nets 137-107 on Wednesday night. Chicago had all five starters in double figures by the end of its 76-point first half and eight players had at least 10 points in the game. The Bulls made a franchise-record 15 3-pointers in the first half and finished with 21.
